eventDetail.scope: With technically co-sponsored by IEEE Algeria Section, The International Conference on Advanced Electrical Engineering is the premier event of the IEEE Algerian Section and ‘’AAGEE’’, the Algerian Association on Electrical and Electronics Engineering, founded in 2016 with the purpose of improving communication between groups and individuals that work within the multidisciplinary field of Electrical Engineering in Algeria and elsewhere. The 4th edition of ICAEE will be held from 21 to 23 November 2026 at EcoleNationalePolytechnique, Algiers, Algeria. The program will feature world-class plenary speakers for emerging topics, as well as sessions covering the latest research and innovation in the field.
